claims.statement: The shipped manifold-eval workflow exports the after checkpoint through the existing bridge, reloads both before and after pipelines from native, runs same-noise generation, decodes through the shared LatentDecoder (float32 with norm_float16 disabled) plus min_max_to_unit, scores with PairedFidelityMetrics for the paired policy, and writes metrics.json plus one slice_grid_*.png per sample under --output. The policy is inferred from the before native artifact's pipeline_class; there is no mode flag.

The observe-only in-training paired-fidelity monitor (ADR-0037) is now shipped: PairedFidelityCallback lives at src/manifold/metrics/paired_callback.py and is registered on the CallbackRegistry via PairedFidelitySpec at src/manifold/training/callbacks/paired_fidelity.py, exported from manifold.training.callbacks alongside TrainLossSpec, FIDSpec, and CheckpointSpec.

The supervised ControlNet CLI ships with the monitor default-on: it registers paired_fidelity on its TrainingSpine registry, includes it in default_names=[train_loss, checkpoint, paired_fidelity], and constructs CallbackContext with inference_recipe={'num_inference_steps': int(num_inference_steps)} filled from the controlnet.num_inference_steps recipe knob. LatentX0MAE remains the hand-appended extra_callbacks member so the checkpoint can still monitor val/x0_mae.

min_max_to_unit is the single shared normalization contract across three sites: the ControlNet inference pipeline's __call__ decode path, BeforeAfterEval._decode_normalize, and PairedFidelityCallback.on_validation_epoch_end. All three sites call the same per-volume min-max normalization and the resulting [0, 1] volumes are scored by PairedFidelityMetrics with data_range=1.0, so the in-training val/psnr / val/ssim and the offline metrics.json are directly comparable.

The monitor's rollout step count is recipe-primary: PairedFidelitySpec.num_inference_steps defaults to None, PairedFidelitySpec.build reads num_inference_steps from ctx.inference_recipe['num_inference_steps'] (the supervised spine fills it from controlnet.num_inference_steps), an explicit per-callback value overrides the recipe, and a literal default of 15 applies when neither is set.

The fixed paired subset is resolved lazily at the first gated epoch (F5): PairedFidelitySpec.build forwards ctx.datamodule and PairedFidelityCallback._paired_dataset reads getattr(source, 'val_latent_ds', source) at first use, so the cold-path datamodule's post-setup() replacement of val_latent_ds (issue #145 / ADR-0017) is honored without capturing the dataset at build time. The subset itself is a seeded randperm prefix of subset_size collated and cached, so the same subjects are scored every gated epoch.

Under DDP the monitor uses redundant evaluation: every rank evaluates the same fixed subset under DDP-synchronized weights and identical seeded noise, so the per-rank result is identical and Lightning's torchmetrics sync on the two module-attached MeanMetric instances is the only cross-rank reduction. There is no FID-style sharding and no error-rendezvous machinery. The 2-rank DDP gate in tests/test_paired_fidelity_ddp.py locks both the no-hang and the identical per-rank value claims (reading the rank-LOCAL mean_value directly off the module-attached MeanMetric).

The in-training monitor is observe-only by contract: the supervised ControlNet CLI's monitor_metric stays val/x0_mae (emitted by the hand-appended LatentX0MAE extra callback), the rollout runs under torch.inference_mode() so no gradient is ever formed, the monitor never enters the loss and never touches the optimizer / EMA. PairedFidelitySpec.logged_metrics declares frozenset({'val/psnr', 'val/ssim'}) so validate_monitor accepts them as validatable monitors, but no shell sets monitor_metric=val/psnr or val/ssim. Releasing the blanket forbidden_callbacks={'fid'} for this monitor on the ControlNet-GRPO path is a deliberate follow-up (ADR-0037 §GRPO stage), not part of this change.

ComparisonPageBuilder is library-only: there is no manifold-build-page console entry and the pyproject.toml [project.scripts] table does not list it (ADR-0033). The builder reads metrics.json, optionally reads JiT val/fid and val/mean_reward series from Lightning metrics.csv files via MetricsPlotCallback._read_series, and embeds both generated curves and slice grids as base64 PNG data URIs through _data_uri. The assembled HTML carries no script, link, or http(s):// reference and is written atomically via .tmp + os.replace. When no ControlNetComparison is supplied, the builder emits a clearly marked pending slot rather than inventing a comparison.

BeforeAfterEval creates the same-noise contract in two ways: for JiT / unconditional each pipeline receives a fresh torch.Generator(device).manual_seed(seed) so both start noises are identical; for ControlNet / paired the driver draws one noise tensor from torch.Generator(device).manual_seed(seed) and passes the same tensor to both sample_latent calls while holding the source latent, real target latent, spacing, contrast labels, and Heun step count fixed. Differences are therefore attributable to the policy weights rather than sampling stochasticity.

The eval policy is inferred from the before native artifact's pipeline_class: _pipeline_class_of reads model_index.json and maps LatentFlowPipeline to run_unconditional (taking --latent-shape, --num-samples, --modality, --spacing, and a fixed seed) and ControlNetLatentFlowPipeline to run_paired (taking held-out src/tgt latent pairs, spacing, contrast labels, and a fixed seed). There is no mode flag. The CLI loads a probe pipeline from the before export, bakes the after ckpt into /after_native via the existing export bridge (so the ControlNet frozen base is reused and only the trainable controlnet.* weights are baked), then reloads both native exports into fresh pipelines.

ADR-0037 marks releasing the blanket forbidden_callbacks={'fid'} for paired fidelity on the ControlNet-GRPO path as a deliberate follow-up: paired fidelity uses controlnet_rollout, so the FID rationale (unconditional rollout ignores the ControlNet) does not apply. The supervised stage lands first; the GRPO ControlNet path's paired_fidelity registration remains out of scope until that follow-up is filed.
